turns.doctor_question: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me, I really appreciate your time. Um, well, I hope I'm in the right place. I guess what brings me in is... well, it's probably nothing too serious, I'm sure, but I've been having this sort of constant restless feeling? 

It's just kind of like I’m wound a little too tight, and I can’t seem to fully settle down. Even when I’m supposed to be calmly sitting through a planning meeting at work, or, you know, trying to relax by painting or doing yoga. I just always have this low-level hum where I can't quite sit still, which I know probably makes me look a bit flighty to other people. Is that... does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it okay, I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.

symptom_reasoning.S013: The patient describes an inability to settle down and relax during leisure activities like painting or doing yoga.
symptom_reasoning.S058: The patient describes feeling 'wound a little too tight' and restless, which matches feeling keyed up or on edge.

turns.doctor_question: Do you often have trouble concentrating or staying focused?

Oh, um, no, not really. I don't think I have a problem with that. I mean, as a retail buyer, I have to look through a lot of inventory spreadsheets and vendor catalogs, and I can stay focused on the actual work just fine. 

It's more just... my body wanting to move while I'm doing it? But my mind is completely on task. I definitely don't want to give the impression that I'm falling behind at my job or anything, because I really do pay attention and get my work done. I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm answering your question correctly.

Oh, um, inattention? No, I don't think I had trouble with that. I mean, I always tried really hard to be a good student, and I definitely wasn't losing things or anything like that.

But, um, I suppose when I'm on calls with suppliers... my foot is usually bouncing under the desk. And I might be, you know, clicking a pen or twisting my ring around. Actually, I sometimes have to make sure I mute myself or keep my hands off camera so it doesn't distract anyone. 

I really try to keep it under control, though! I don't want my vendors to think I'm not taking our meetings seriously, because I absolutely am. It's just a little way to channel that extra energy while I'm sitting still. Is that the kind of thing you meant? I hope I'm explaining it right.
